title: Faster storefront image selection and initial content
summary: Removed duplicate hero images and delayed content visibility; parallelized optional homepage data and bounded its response time.

changes.detail: One responsive picture selects desktop OR mobile hero; mutually exclusive preload hints replace two eager image elements and duplicate backdrop layers. Supported remote images use the existing optimizer, with original-source fallback.
Hero headline, action buttons and image appear without entrance delays. Catalogue is visible in initial HTML; scroll effects progressively enhance only offscreen content.
Ecomedia read starts alongside catalogue/settings requests, and optional banner/post reads have 1.8-second timeouts.

validation.name: Public baseline
validation.detail: curl HTTP 200: uncompressed HTML 603935 bytes, TTFB 3.301s, total 12.901s; compressed request 54011 bytes, TTFB 3.132s, total 4.295s. These are single-request environment-specific observations, not browser Core Web Vitals. Public HTML contained four hero image elements.

validation.name: Pending code validation
validation.detail: Focused regression tests, lint and TypeScript/build checks pending. Changes not deployed; no production speed improvement claimed.
